_comment: LAST WEEK's prints - 24-28 August 2026 - as a backtest calendar.
This is the out-of-sample set: these ten reported before the strategy
existed, so nothing here was fitted to them.
CRITICAL, and the reason this is a separate file: 'history' holds the four
prints BEFORE the 24-28 Aug one, never that print itself. The vol screen
ranks on implied-vs-realised, so including the outcome of the very print
being tested would be look-ahead bias - the screen would rank a name using
a number it could not have had.
'actual_reaction_pct' is the outcome, recorded for scoring the run AFTER
the fact. Nothing in the strategy reads it - load_calendar ignores the key.
